title: Friday Night Magic 2016: card flavor text

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of the minds of the Eldrazi as unsolvable puzzles.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Alien beings whose minds are described as puzzles that can never be solved.

entities.name: Zada of Slab Haven
entities.description: A speaker who remarks on old relics being made of smithereens.

entities.name: Greenweaver Mina
entities.description: A speaker describing a blighted place where Zendikar's bones lay bare.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose skin is described as peeled back to bare its bones.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who says that as long as there is life, there is hope.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A speaker who warns that the Blind Eternities can kill those without the planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: A realm whose merest touch can kill those without the planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Planeswalker spark
entities.description: The spark that protects planeswalkers from the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer who taunts her brother about sharing his toys with Ludevic and boasts of new playmates.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: Someone with whom Gisa's brother has shared his toys.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire who appealed to Olivia Voldaren to summon her bloodline.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who summoned the full might of her bloodline at Sorin's appeal.

entities.name: Lurenbraum Fortress
entities.description: The fortress where Olivia's bloodline gathered.

events.summary: Defenders face a single Eldrazi yet are outnumbered.
events.quote: Only one Eldrazi stood against them, yet the defenders were outnumbered.

events.summary: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summons her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.
events.quote: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.
